memories.content: The atlas release build keeps getting cancelled by CI (2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, 2026-08-29) because it starts every run with an empty cargo registry cache, which adds ~18 minutes, leaving almost no margin under the pipeline's 30-minute hard cancellation timeout; any minor slowdown pushes the build over and it gets killed.
